pipeline.note: PCA motion flag 2.553>2.5 (41% recall, 0% FP) + anisotropy=1.6587 (near 1.7) + gm_ratio=0.3596 (strong blur, spectral_slope_ratio=1.151). Family chosen over deterministic gaussian/lens (they cap at 25.68/25.52 dB with sigma=4/radius=6, angle-independent) and glass (22.76 dB): motion best 32.54 dB at JPEG q25. Severity UNCERTAIN because blur_motion samples a random angle(-90..90) per application -> repeat runs of the same pipeline span 22.02-32.54 dB.

block_boundary=2.136 >> 1.1 (0% FP per exp17/18) -> JPEG confirmed; dct_zero_ratio=0.9655; unique_G=256. JPEG 1-5 scan PSNR best at sev1/sev2 (23.81/23.91 JPEG-only; 32.54 combined at sev1). Signal-mode block_boundary matched on pair 0 with jpeg:1. sev1=q25 is the mildest available level.

alternatives.function_family: blur_gaussian (cross-family deterministic control; below 30dB quality bar, kept for training-time arbitration only)

stats.note: JPEG severity +1 variant; highest CI of all candidates

analysis.mode: PSNR (noise_prior sigma=0.74 < 2 -> PSNR allowed) + SIGNAL for motion-robust verification (motion angle is random so PSNR is angle-noise limited)
analysis.rationale: Two-step pipeline: blur then JPEG (physical camera order). JPEG existence is high confidence (block_boundary 0% FP); blur presence is unambiguous (gm_ratio=0.3596; JPEG-only sim only reaches 23.9 dB vs 32.5 dB combined). Blur subtype: deterministic families (gaussian sigma=4, lens radius=6) are angle-independent yet plateau at ~25.6 dB, while motion peaks at 32.54 dB and carries the PCA motion flag (0% FP) plus near-threshold anisotropy; motion also has random angle, explaining 10 dB run-to-run PSNR spread and low Wiener-kernel correlation. Support validation (signal mode, pairs 1-4): spectral_slope matched 3/4 (only pair 3 diff 0.121), block_boundary matched 1/4 (diffs 10-15% vs 8% threshold), Wiener corr 0.21-0.78 (angle-dependent as expected for re-sampled motion). Noise ruled out: peeled residual noise_prior sigma=1.48 < 2; §B extreme_pct=50% and spatial_corr=0.99 are known JPEG/blur-artifact false positives on structured (angle-mismatch) residual. No global (variance_ratio=0.9645, mean_shift=-0.3).

noise_6step_check.diagnosis: NO_NOISE: peeled-residual noise_prior sigma=1.48 (<2); extreme_pct/vm_slope/spatial_corr are inflated by structured motion-angle-mismatch residual (spatial_corr~0.99), classic SKILL failure-mode false positives.
